title: Ken O'Sullivan: Stories from the Sea
summary: A live show by filmmaker Ken O'Sullivan featuring his 25-year journey exploring the North Atlantic.
description: Ken O'Sullivan presents a live show titled Stories from the Sea, featuring his experiences exploring the North Atlantic Ocean and seas around Ireland. The event combines film and stories from his 20-plus year career, including personal insights from being surrounded by killer whales, swimming with dolphins, and encounters with fin and blue whales. O'Sullivan has produced more than twenty natural history documentaries for RTÉ, and his series North Atlantic was acquired by the BBC and broadcast in over 30 countries. He also features alongside David Attenborough in BBC Earth's Stunning Underwater Nature Footage, which has 7 million views on YouTube. The show pays homage to his family's 250-year history on Fenit Island, Co. Kerry, and discusses education and conservation, which have been central to his work since 2005. His documentaries are included in the secondary school exam curriculum for Junior Cycle Geography and Business Studies. His book, Stories from the Deep, is critically acclaimed for its writing and descriptions of nature. The event takes place at 15 MacCurtain Street, Victorian Quarter, Cork, from 19:30 to 21:10 on 26 September 2026.

title: The Piano by Irish National Opera
summary: Irish National Opera presents 'The Piano' with a Steinway B piano on Sunday, 18 October at 8pm.
description: Irish National Opera presents 'The Piano', a musical performance featuring a Steinway B piano at the Cork Opera House. The event welcomes the Steinway B to Cork Opera House and takes place on Sunday, 18 October at 8pm. Booking is recommended to attend this musical performance. Cork Opera House prioritizes inclusion and accessibility, noting that these values are very important to them. Visitors can purchase gift vouchers to treat friends or family to a night at the venue. The Cork Opera House also hosts Some Dose Coffee Co., which is now open with hours from Mon-Fri, 8.30AM-3PM. For more information or tickets, contact the Cork Opera House Box Office at 01785 619080. The venue is located at Emmet Place, Cork City, Ireland, T12 DW6P. title: Love Actually Charity Gala 2026 at Clontarf Castle
summary: An evening of music, stories, and generosity supporting children and families through Love Actually Charity.
description: The Love Actually Charity Gala 2026 takes place on Sunday, 18 October 2026, from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM at the Clontarf Castle Hotel on Castle Avenue, Dublin 3. The event lasts four hours and is organized by Love Actually Charity to support children and families. The evening includes opening remarks, a charity documentary, and speeches by Dr Sinead Kane and Councillor Hazel Chu. Performances feature Youth Classical Dance, the Love Actually Charity Team, the Westland Trio Baroque Ensemble (WTBE), Tang Jiarui playing guitar and vocals, and the Love Actually Kids Camp Team. The schedule also includes charity auctions and raffles. Guests can attend as a Gala Guest for 108 EUR, book a full table for 10 people for 1,074 EUR, or a half table for 5 people for 537 EUR.

title: Bram Stoker Festival 2026: Four Days & Nights
summary: A Dublin City Council festival returning Oct 23-26, 2026, with events for gothic enthusiasts and families.
description: The Dublin City Council Bram Stoker Festival returns for 2026, running from Friday 23 October to Monday 26 October. The 2026 theme is 'Four Days & Nights of Deadly Adventures'. Dedicated to the legacy of Bram Stoker and the city of Dublin, the festival is brought to life by Dublin City Council and produced and presented by Schweppe Curtis Nunn. It is part of a series dating back to 2017. The programme offers events and activities for gothic enthusiasts and families alike. While the full 2026 programme will be announced in late September 2026, the event has previously engaged the community with literary and cultural activities. In 2025, more than 60,000 people enjoyed the festival.

title: Jurassic Haunt: Jurassic Newpark's 2026 Halloween Experience
summary: A Halloween event in Kilkenny running from 24th October to 1st November 2026, featuring free admission and activities for all ages.
description: Jurassic Haunt is Jurassic Newpark's 2026 Halloween Experience located in County Kilkenny, Ireland. The event runs from 24th October to 1st November. Admission is free. The venue is situated at 26 Ardilea, Castlecomer Rd, Newpark Lower, Kilkenny, R95 XP5H, Ireland. The experience is suitable for babies, children under 5, under 9, and under 12. During the event, the park transforms into a magical world of dinosaurs, witches, wizards, wicked surprises, and family-friendly frights. Activities include the Jurassic Sorting Ceremony, hands-on Wizard Class, decorating chocolate apples, magical games, and themed photos. Visitors can explore The Wicked Walk, Haunted Cabin, Haunted Jurassic Castle, and the Spider Tunnel. Families can enjoy the Dino Dance Show, a scavenger hunt for prizes, the Jurassic Halloween Express Train, face painting, and complimentary parking.
